_about: Dictation-style sentences for the jargon, noise and whisper sets. `text` is the reference (punctuated, as it should be written); `names` must come out spelled exactly.

sentences.text: Can you push the Supabase migration before lunch?
The Vercel deploy failed again, so check the logs.
I moved the cache from Redis to Postgres last week.
Ask Priya to review the Kubernetes config tomorrow.
We should try Tailwind for the new landing page.
Did Mateo merge the GraphQL change, or is it still open?
Our Cloudflare bill doubled after the launch.
Let's switch the queue from Kafka to RabbitMQ.
Can Siobhan send me the Figma file before the meeting?
The Docker image is too big, so trim the dependencies.
Rohan says the Stripe webhook is timing out.
Put the secrets in Doppler, not in the repo.
I think Prisma is generating the wrong types.
Tell Aisha the Datadog alerts are too noisy.
Is the Firebase project still on the free plan?
We need Terraform for the staging environment.
Ping Ngozi about the Sentry errors from last night.
The Svelte rewrite is faster, but the bundle grew.
Can you check whether Nginx is caching the API?
Joaquin wants the Grafana dashboard by Friday.
Let's move the cron jobs to GitHub Actions.

Ask Dmitri if the DynamoDB table needs an index.
Our Django app still runs on the old server.
I'll set up Elasticsearch after the demo.
Is Larynx running on the Neural Engine yet?
Can you open the Locust repo and run the tests?
We tried Ollama, but the model was too slow.
Send the Anthropic invoice to Ingrid.
The Heroku dyno keeps restarting every hour.
Did Kwame finish the Swift package update?
Please rename the Webpack config before you commit.
Lucia found a bug in the FastAPI routes.
Let's benchmark SQLite against Postgres for this.
Can Yusuf join the call about the Netlify outage?
The Laravel admin panel needs two-factor login.
I'm meeting Anika at the office on Thursday.
Our Upstash Redis keeps hitting the rate limit.
Can you ask Oluwaseun to approve the pull request?
The Drizzle schema is out of sync with production.

babble: The weather has been strange all week and nobody knows why.
I picked up groceries on the way home and forgot the milk again.
They said the train would be late, so we took a taxi instead.
My sister is moving to a new apartment across town next month.
The game went into overtime and everyone was shouting at the screen.
We should plan a trip to the coast before the summer ends.
The coffee shop on the corner closed, which is a real shame.
He kept talking about his garden for at least twenty minutes.
